---
title: "TAOOH second-order Markov model, unadjusted — estimand"
subtitle: "Weeks alive and out of hospital over 26 weeks"
format: html
---

- Standardised over fitted participants, keeping their random intercepts

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(mostr)
library(ggdist)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "posterior.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$main

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
stopifnot(horizon_days %% 7 == 0)
horizon_weeks <- as.integer(horizon_days / 7)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "05-unadjusted-second-order", "results")
estimand_dir <- here(results_dir, "estimand")
figure_dir <- here(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Post-estimation files carry the number of draws in their name, so changing
# posterior_draws$main recomputes them.
estimand_path <- function(kind) {
  here(estimand_dir, sprintf("%s-01-draws-%d.parquet", kind, n_draws))
}
```

## Post-estimation

```{r}
#| label: post-estimation
#| include: false

if (!file.exists(estimand_path("comparisons-draws"))) {
  model <- readRDS(here(results_dir, "models", "model-01.rds"))

  sops <- avg_sops(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5,
    p_var = "yprev",
    p2_var = "ypprev",
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = 1L,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )

  comparisons <- avg_comparisons(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    estimand = "time_in_state",
    state_sets = 1,
    times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    p_var = "yprev",
    p2_var = "ypprev",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = 1L,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )

  sop_draws <- attr(sops, "draws")
  comparison_draws <- attr(comparisons, "draws")
  stopifnot(
    "TAOOH post-estimation results must retain posterior draws." =
      !is.null(sop_draws) && !is.null(comparison_draws)
  )

  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sops),
    estimand_path("sops-summary"),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sop_draws),
    estimand_path("sops-draws"),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparisons),
    estimand_path("comparisons-summary"),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  # Written last: its existence marks the post-estimation as complete.
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparison_draws),
    estimand_path("comparisons-draws"),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}
```

## Treatment difference

```{r}
#| label: treatment-difference
#| include: false

comparison_draws <- read_parquet(estimand_path("comparisons-draws")) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  "TAOOH comparison draws must contain draw_id and estimate." =
    all(c("draw_id", "estimate") %in% names(comparison_draws)),
  "TAOOH must contain one matched treatment contrast per posterior draw." =
    nrow(comparison_draws) == n_draws && !anyDuplicated(comparison_draws$draw_id)
)

# imputation = 1 keeps the file format of the adjusted model.
home_time_draws <- comparison_draws |>
  mutate(imputation = 1L, draw = estimate) |>
  select(
    draw_id,
    imputation,
    draw,
    any_of(c("contrast", "comparison", "term", "state"))
  )

home_time_summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(home_time_draws$draw) |>
  mutate(
    probability_benefit = posterior_probability(home_time_draws$draw),
    state = 1L,
    horizon_weeks = horizon_weeks,
    imputations = 1L,
    draws_per_imputation = n_draws
  )

write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(home_time_summary),
  here(results_dir, "home-time-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  home_time_draws,
  here(results_dir, "home-time-comparison-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## State occupancy probabilities

```{r}
#| label: state-occupancy
#| include: false

state_labels <- c(
  "Alive/out of hospital",
  "Planned admission",
  "Emergency room",
  "Unplanned admission",
  "Dead"
)

sop_draws <- read_parquet(estimand_path("sops-draws")) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  "TAOOH SOP draws must contain draw_id, estimate, time, state, and tx." =
    all(c("draw_id", "estimate", "time", "state", "tx") %in% names(sop_draws)),
  "The TAOOH SOP object must contain the configured posterior draws." =
    n_distinct(sop_draws$draw_id) == n_draws
)

sop_summary <- sop_draws |>
  mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = 1:5, labels = state_labels),
    tx = group_factor(tx)
  ) |>
  group_by(tx, time, state) |>
  summarise(
    conf.low = quantile(estimate, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    conf.high = quantile(estimate, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    estimate = median(estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_parquet(
  sop_summary,
  here(results_dir, "state-occupancy-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-figures
#| include: false

model_sop_plot <- plot_sops(
  sop_summary,
  time_var = "time",
  facet_var = NULL,
  linetype_var = "tx"
) +
  scale_colour_state() +
  scale_fill_state() +
  scale_linetype_group() +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2),
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "State occupancy probability",
    colour = "TAOOH state",
    fill = "TAOOH state",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  model_sop_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "model-state-occupancy-pooled.png"),
  height = 5
)

home_time_posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  home_time_draws,
  x_label = paste0(
    "Difference in time alive and out of hospital over ",
    horizon_weeks,
    " weeks (ctDNA − usual care), weeks"
  )
)

save_figure(
  home_time_posterior_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "home-time-difference-posterior.png"),
  height = 5
)
```
